title: Icon conformance audit across mock pages
goal: Some places in the study still stand in a typed character or an emoji where an icon belongs, so those spots look wrong next to the real icons. This finds every one and replaces it with a proper icon from the shared set.
notes:
Objective: design-system > icon-conformance (epic staged 'later'; parent 'design-system' staged 'next'). Focus epic is measure-redline.

SWEEP RUN 2026-08-24 BEFORE DROPPING — THE PREMISE DOES NOT HOLD. The study is already icon-conformant; there is no work to do here as written.

Method: three passes over all 91 files in docs/design/mocks/pages plus 62 in shared/components.
  Pass 1, every non-ASCII pictographic/arrow/geometric codepoint: 1290 raw hits across 114 files.
  Pass 2, minus keycap context and dimension separators: 146.
  Pass 3, minus multipliers, keycap strings and code-comment prose: 96, all read by hand.

All 96 survivors are correct typography, not icons standing in for icons:
  - keycap glyphs in shortcut labels (⌘ ⌥ ⇧ ⌃ ⌦ ⎋ ↩) — 736 of the raw hits; correct macOS convention
  - <kbd>← →</kbd> and <kbd>↑ ↓</kbd> documenting arrow keys (lang-resize.html:270, layers-pane.html:377,624)
  - × as a multiplier or dimension separator (×3, 2×, 5×, '1024 × 768', 'Variant × state matrix')
  - → and › as prose connectors in body copy and ASCII diagrams inside CSS/JS comments
  - − as a negative value in a grade readout (img-grade-wt.html:296,321)
  - •••••••• as a password field mask (ui-entry-wt.html:106) — the right glyph for that job
ZERO emoji in the entire study: pass 1 matched U+1F300–U+1FAFF and U+2600–U+27BF and returned no hits at all.

Second half of the claim, 'non ic-* icon styles', also does not hold. 220 distinct ic-* names are in use.
Inline <svg> appears in 19 pages and every instance is artwork or content, not an icon: redline arrows
(capture-wt, walk), boolean shape demos (draw-boolean), audio waveforms (video-audio), dashboard charts,
the 24x24 icon-design artboard (icon-draw-wt).

ONLY REAL DRIFT FOUND, and it is cosmetic-neutral, so it does not justify re-filing on its own:
  shared/components/inspector.css:163 hand-inlines a close cross as a ::after mask
  shared/components/inspector.css:301 hand-inlines a chevron-updown as a <select> background-image
Both already use the house grid (24 viewBox, 1.75 stroke, round caps/joins), so neither looks wrong next to
the real set. Neither can take a .ic-* class: one is a pseudo-element, the other is a native <select>
background. Fixing them means exporting the data URIs from shared/icons.mjs as CSS custom properties so
these two call sites reference the source of truth instead of copying it. That is a build-plumbing change
to build-icons.mjs, worth ~30 minutes, and worth doing only if design-system is ever staged 'now'.
acceptance: A sweep over every page finds no typed characters, symbols or emoji being used as icons
Any icon that was missing is added to the shared icon set and regenerated rather than pasted into one page
Every touched page loads without error
